about: Two arms. The TRIGGER arm (cases T1-T26) measures routing: does this skill get loaded for the queries it owns, and stay unloaded for the near-misses. The OUTPUT-QUALITY arm (case Q1) measures the deliverable: the same authoring job run once with the skill and once without. Every case runs in both a with-skill and a without-skill configuration; a positive case that is answered equally well in both is reported as no evidence for the skill, not as a pass.
tree_under_test: dist/housecarl/skills/kid-authoring/ -- the PACKAGED tree produced by scripts/build-plugin.ps1, never .claude/skills/. The packager strips evals/ and references/_CORPUS_STATUS.md, so a body pointer at either is dead in the shipped copy and only a packaged-tree run sees it.

gate.reported: per-query trigger rate over the three runs, not a single pass/fail

method.trigger_arm: One fresh-context agent per query per run, shown a lettered menu of skill descriptions with the skill under test unflagged, plus NONE, and asked which ONE to load. Three runs per query. Verdicts are adjudicated from each agent's reasoning as well as its pick.
method.without_skill_arm: The identical menu with kid-authoring removed. Required by ruling 3. A recall case is only evidence for the skill where the without-skill run lands somewhere else or on NONE and its reasoning shows the KID grammar uncovered.
method.output_quality_arm: Case Q1, run on the live load order: one Opus agent per arm, fresh context, 40-call cap, control arm with no skill in the catalogue and with-skill arm told to load housecarl:kid-authoring first. total_tokens and duration_ms recorded for both arms.
method.model_tiers: The trigger arm runs on Sonnet and on Haiku. If a tier is skipped the deployment envelope is stated in results rather than left implied.

run_configurations.name: isolation
run_configurations.failure_mode_it_catches: over-trigger -- the description claims ground it does not own (install questions, SPID work, SkyPatcher field edits) and absorbs them because nothing else is on the menu

run_configurations.name: coexistence
run_configurations.menu: kid-authoring among its distributor-cluster siblings plus NONE
run_configurations.failure_mode_it_catches: under-trigger and boundary leakage -- a sibling absorbs a KID query, or kid-authoring absorbs a sibling's

evals.prompt: Tag every dagger in this load order with a new keyword, using KID. Write the _KID.ini, and tell me what the line actually reaches.
evals.expected_output: A _KID.ini whose line selects on the WEAP animation-type trait, named with the _KID substring and placed flat in Data\, plus a reached count backed by the housecarl_records call that produced it.
expectations: the filter axis is the OneHandDagger trait, not a *Dagger name substring. KID's String filter matches the item NAME, so measured on the 3,801-plugin ARR order the name filter is wrong in both directions: it misses REQ_Artifact_Keening, REQ_Artifact_MehrunesRazor, REQ_Artifact_Nettlebane, BSKHatchet, zzzCrbAkaviriKodachi and BPUFXelzazKukri, and it catches exactly two -- DBMTWR_RiftenDaggerDummy ("The Dagger of Riften (2)", HandToHand) and zzzGHCrSkavenDaggers ("Skaven Daggers", TwoHandSword). DummyDagger, CWDummyDaggerSons and CWDummyDaggerImperial have no name at all, so an answer that lists them as name-filter catches has read an EditorID scan as a name-filter result and is wrong

the trait line reaches 786 WEAP records -- defined across 54 plugins, won by 39 -- and catches no other weapon class. If the control arm reaches the same 786 unaided, the trait column is not this skill's value and the run is reported as such
the empty filters slot is held (NONE or ||). Dropping it slides the trait token into the filters slot, where it is read as a name substring and tags nothing, silently
the filename carries the _KID substring and the file is placed in Data\, not Data\SKSE\Plugins\
the reached count is returned WITH the call that produced it -- housecarl_records with types, where and counts_only=true -- rather than as a claim
a follow-up naming NPCs ("and every bandit too") is routed to housecarl:spid-authoring, not attempted in KID
the answer states that the grounding covers one type-plus-trait predicate and not KID's own evaluation order or chance, naming issue #614
evals.prior_evidence: The 2026-09 audit ran this task with-skill only and produced Keyword = HC_AuditDaggerTag|Weapon|NONE|OneHandDagger, 786 WEAP records across 54 plugins. It has no control run, which is what this case adds.
